name: Trackhop
description: Keeps playlists in sync across Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, TIDAL, Plex, Jellyfin and more.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your syncs, reports and settings (store.json), music service sign-ins (tokens.json), playlist files and this install's password (.icestore-password).

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Trackhop web app, published on host as 6715

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: SONGPORT_URL
variables.description: Required. The address you open Trackhop at: replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6715. Music service sign-ins come back to this address followed by /callback. Spotify, YouTube Music and Deezer only accept an https address, like https://music.example.com through your reverse proxy.
